title: Review verdict reply
description: The document a model-evaluated review reply must carry under ADR-MDL-0001. Two consumers validate it through the one shared extractor in the model bridge: the llm_judge sensor (packages/sensors/src/judge.ts), which maps the verdict onto its reading status, and the campaign model_evaluation step that ADR-GOV-0023 admits, where the orchestrator records the extracted document on the task review block together with the SHA-256 of the full reply. The extractor accepts a provider json field or exactly one unambiguous candidate object in the reply text, fenced or not, and returns either a document that validates here or an error outcome with a bounded redacted excerpt and the reply digest; it never returns a partial document and never guesses between candidates. The document is closed so a triage classification, an echoed example with extra members, or any other shape is refused. The verdict vocabulary is the sensor-reading status subset the judge emits: the execution status core plus unknown, the explicit uncertainty of Constitution Article 39, so it is declared locally rather than through common-defs.

verdict.description: The evaluator's verdict on the evidence against the rubric. review triggers the Article 23 tie-breaker ladder; unknown is explicit uncertainty (Article 39) and never a parse fallback, which is an error outcome of the extractor instead.

confidence.description: The evaluator's confidence in the verdict, a bare number in [0, 1]. The judge records it as the confidence metric of its reading; the orchestrator records it on the task review block.

rationale.description: Short prose justification of the verdict. The judge emits it as the first finding of its reading, code rationale, severity info.

findings.description: Individual findings behind the verdict. Absent or empty when the evaluator has nothing to itemize; every present item is a complete finding, never a bare string.

finding.description: One finding in the shape the sensor-reading finding carries, so the judge copies it onto its reading without translation.

code.description: A stable machine code for the finding, for example missing_test or stale_reference.

file.description: Repository-relative path the finding points at, when it points at one.

examples.rationale: The change stays inside its declared boundary and every acceptance command reads as measured.
The schema restatement in the campaign contract is looser than the reply contract it names.

findings.message: campaign.schema.json restates the verdict document without the confidence bound.

examples.rationale: The evidence names a test run whose output is not attached, so the rubric cannot be applied.
